title: Intel Core i9 14900K 14th Gen Raptor Lake Processor

items.h: Clock Speed: 3.20 GHz up to 6.00 GHz
Cache: 36 MB Intel Smart Cache, Socket: LGA1700

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel Core i9-14900K 14th Gen Raptor Lake Refresh Processor is one of the fastest consumer desktop CPUs ever released, built for high-end gaming and extreme productivity workloads.

Featuring 24 cores (8 Performance-cores + 16 Efficient-cores) and 32 threads, this flagship processor delivers unmatched multitasking, rendering, video editing, 4K gaming, and AI-driven performance. With a blazing up to 6.0GHz Max Turbo Frequency, support for DDR5 and DDR4 memory, and full PCIe 5.0 compatibility, the i9-14900K is the perfect choice for gamers, creators, streamers, engineers, and professionals who demand top-tier performance from their PC.

Key Features

  • 24 Cores & 32 Threads (8P + 16E Cores)
  • Up to 6.0GHz Max Turbo Frequency for extreme speed
  • Intel UHD Graphics 770 integrated GPU
  • 36MB Intel Smart Cache
  • 125W Base Power, up to 253W Turbo Power
  • Supports DDR5-5600 & DDR4-3200
  • PCIe 5.0 / 4.0 ready
  • Unlocked “K” Series – excellent for overclocking
  • LGA 1700 Socket – compatible with Z790, Z690, B760, B660 motherboards
  • Designed for 4K gaming, streaming, rendering & heavy workloads
